prose: The MicroZig and Zig Embedded Group projects adopted one of the strictest no-AI policies yet: no LLM-generated code or prose, no paraphrasing LLM output, no LLM editing including spelling and grammar fixes, no LLM translation, no LLM-assisted brainstorming shared in the space, no LLMs for finding bugs, and no talking about chatbot use at all.

The policy, modeled on Zig's Code of Conduct, took effect October 28, 2026 across the GitHub organization and Discord. Posting in one's native language is explicitly welcome - translation is the reader's problem, not a reason to use a model.
highlights: MicroZig bans all LLM-generated content, code or prose
Extends to editing, translation, brainstorming and bug-finding
Even discussing chatbot use is barred in the project spaces
Effective October 28, 2026; modeled on Zig's CoC
